supportPointQA.method: Read-only alpha segmentation of lowest8percent silhouette, equal weighting of separated boot intervals; lowest sole determines floor; retain far-foot perspective height difference.

prompt: Create exactly ONE finished 2D fighting-game character sprite on a completely transparent RGBA background. One full body only, isolated, entire head/hair, hands, all equipment and both boot soles fully inside the canvas with modest clear margins. Tall portrait canvas; character occupies about 87% of height. Right-facing three-quarter side view looking at the opponent to the right, grounded neutral combat-ready stance, no action sequence, no sprite sheet, no additional views, no text, no labels, no scenery, no glow cloud, no ground shadow, no rotation. Crisp detailed hand-painted/cel-shaded 2D game art with clean readable contours, natural anatomy and coherent mechanical detail. Use the attached identity reference ONLY for the appropriate same-period character, especially face, hairstyle, age, stature and defining equipment. The attachment contains multiple poses; choose its top-left standing figure as identity reference and render just one newly drawn figure. This is a NEW ORIGINAL CQC alternative costume, not an official Konami outfit and not a recovery of a lost image. CUNNINGHAM-inspired original autonomous METAL GEAR machine, based only on the color/shape codes of his Portable Ops incarnation in the reference, NOT a person in a suit and NOT a visible pilot. Costume OC-009 Plateforme d’interrogation, corrected to follow the user’s machine-only rule: build one fully nonhuman compact bipedal field interrogation robot, broad armored rectangular olive-green torso chassis resembling stacked tactical vest panels and three equipment-box plates; black graphite ribbed understructure, narrow yellow horizontal hazard bands recalling Cunningham straps. A low rectangular black sensor bar and single side-mounted camera cluster serve as its head unit; absolutely no human face, hair, bandana cloth, skin, skull, human torso, man-shaped breastplate, seated person, cockpit occupant or organic details. Two plausibly engineered asymmetric support legs: one thinner silver hydraulic shock-strut leg with flat stabilizer foot recalling his prosthesis only as engineering code, one robust black armored articulated leg with broad flat mechanical foot. Two tool arms mounted on real shoulder hardpoints: near arm with interrogator/survey scanner probe and far arm with multi-prong clamp, tucked in neutral stance; no floating pieces. All pivots, load-bearing joints and cable runs visible and credible. Full single machine isolated facing right in three-quarter side profile, no scene. Preserve the historical pilot-seat brief only in metadata; this NEW draw deliberately implements user-authorized all-machine interpretation.
